scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc6 -p tsconfig.concord.json && pnpm --filter @niceeval/repo-tools run typecheck && pnpm --filter @niceeval/e2e-runner run typecheck && pnpm --filter niceeval run typecheck && pnpm --filter niceeval exec tsc -p ../../docs/feature/assertions/reference/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: concord check && pnpm run repo docs site prepare && concurrently --names vitest,validate,links "pnpm run lint:vitest" "pnpm run repo docs site validate" "pnpm run repo docs site links"
scripts.lint:vitest: concurrently --names writing,vitest "concord docs check" "vitest run --project lint-docs --project lint-docs-site"
scripts.lint:docs: concurrently --names writing,vitest "concord docs check" "vitest run --project lint-docs"
scripts.lint:docs-site: pnpm run repo docs site prepare && concurrently --names vitest,validate,links "vitest run --project lint-docs-site" "pnpm run repo docs site validate" "pnpm run repo docs site links"
scripts.site:dev: pnpm --filter niceeval run build:package && pnpm --filter @niceeval/site run dev
scripts.site:build: pnpm --filter niceeval run build:package && pnpm --filter @niceeval/site run build:deploy
